messages:
Ravi: heads-up — publish blocked by a regen diff on sample-apps. looks like semver bumped because changelog-generator treats reordered OpenAPI entries as new content.
Priya: paste the regendiff output? hoping it9s just ordering.
Ravi: yep, ordering-only. snippet:
```
- components/schemas/Account.yaml
- components/schemas/Billing.yaml
+ components/schemas/Billing.yaml
+ components/schemas/Account.yaml
```
Ravi: also one flaky integration test mutates the global retry defaults briefly, so typegen output toggles a respawned default.
Owen: two separate fixes: 1) make typegen serializer produce stable order (sorted keys + deterministic traversal), 2) tighten tests so they don9t leak global config.
devex-bot: regendiff job #7602: 2 files ordering-only, 1 test drift detected. deterministic_hash: false
Priya: short-term mitigation: add a CI flag `--stable-serialize` to regen step and set release-gate to ignore ordering-only diffs so we don9t force semver bumps. Long-term: upstream deterministic parse in openapi-parser.
Ravi: can we also make the changelog-generator ignore pure reorder hunks (context: git patch lines that only reorder entries)? that would avoid noise in changelog entries.
Owen: yes, I9ll add a small filter: if regendiff reports only reorderings and content hashes unchanged -> mark as no-semver. cheap and effective.
Priya: repro steps I used locally:
1) checkout branch
2) yarn install
3) NODE_ENV=ci yarn regen:sample-apps
4) run `git status --porcelain` to see changed files (repro without `--stable-serialize`)
Owen: pushed a CI config hotfix (regen: add --stable-serialize) and a release-gate rule tweak that ignores ordering-only diffs.
ci-bot: build #7603: regen job re-run -> PASSED (no regendiff).
Ravi: awesome. Priya, can you open the test fix PR that isolates retry defaults and add a unit asserting serializer stable order?
Priya: PR #780 opened: fixes test teardown, adds stable-serialize unit and a tiny changelog note.
devex-bot: PR scan: changelog entry present; semver impact: none.
Owen: created ticket to upstream parser: DETERMINISTIC-345. will follow up.
Ravi: docs — adding quick note in onboarding: "If regen diffs show up on initial run, re-run with `NODE_ENV=ci yarn regen:sample-apps --stable-serialize` and open a regendiff issue."
ci-bot: build #7610: all sample-app jobs PASSED
Ravi: closing thread 9ll monitor for another day. thanks :tada:
